study: Bottge, Ma, Gassaway, Toland, Butler & Cho (2014), Exceptional Children 80(4):423-437 — Enhanced Anchored Instruction (EAI) math
delivery_evidence: PD main activity was a 2-day summer workshop conducted in person by an experienced EAI teacher who modeled strategies, plus review during the school year (Professional Development section, p.429-430).
test_alignment_evidence: Extracted outcomes include both researcher-developed proximal tests (Fractions Computation Test, Problem-Solving Test) and broad standardized norm-referenced tests (ITBS Computation, ITBS Problem-Solving & Data Interpretation) (Table 3, p.432).
curriculum_evidence: EAI is a specific new blended curriculum of 5 units (computer-based interactive lessons + video-anchored problems + hands-on projects) with daily lesson plans/materials that teachers adopt and use; comparison is business-as-usual (p.427-429).
outcome_timing_evidence: All extracted effect sizes are posttest measured immediately after the 18-week instruction; same school year, no delayed follow-up extracted (timepoint 'post (immediately after 18-week instruction)', Table 3).
